signals.text: DeepSeek open-sourced dsh-superagent: it watches your GitHub, runs requests in parallel worker sessions and replies with a PR. Their own docs say it runs with full OS user access, isolate it first.

DeepSeek released a new open-source agent, DSH SuperAgent: a coding agent that watches GitHub repo events and can open pull requests on its own, with docs explaining step by step how the system was built. (translated from Arabic)

Introducing agent-desktop: agent-browser, for your whole computer. Computer Use for any coding agent on macOS, Windows and Linux; runs in the background while you keep working; agents use your computer in parallel, each with its own cursor.

One agent finds a bug. A fresh agent tries to prove it wrong. Cloudflare's Security Audit skill is MIT licensed. Model costs still apply; it isn't continuous security monitoring. Would you use this before shipping?

GitHub repo review: Directus turns an existing SQL database into a governed backend: instant REST + GraphQL APIs, a visual Studio and an MCP server for AI agents. Use cases: headless CMS, internal tools, data portals and AI-agent workflows.

On the breakout board, leanrea (+304% this week) makes the opposite bet to rea: one small skill file that has the agent reverse-engineer with otool, nm and jadx instead of a server full of tools. Server or skill file, which would you run?

Your coding agent can't hear. earshot (3,016★ in 12 days) gives it ears: CLI, Python API and MCP server that turn audio into evidence an agent can reason about. CPU only. The catch: most CLI calls spend 20-40 s loading models.
mcp servers i'd actually install for a coding agent: 1. context7 (current library docs) 2. chrome-devtools-mcp (console, network, perf traces) 3. github-mcp-server
codebase-memory-mcp is an open source MCP server that turns your codebase into a queryable knowledge graph, so your AI coding agent can answer structural questions without reading files one by one.

Connecting an MCP server is installing software. Treat it that way. On Oct 19, Pillar Security disclosed a critical bug in opencode: on Windows and WSL, a remote MCP server could run code during OAuth sign-in.

I spent the morning kicking the tires on BAND for Developers — the desktop app that gives your AI coding agents a shared room to work in.

Launched 4 days ago (Oct 15) by Thenvoi AI. The pitch: you stop being the middleware between your agents.

Here's how it actually works:

A command center for running coding agents across all your machines. Run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more side by side. Link machines with a password, no SSH keys or port forwarding. On GitHub → autonomous-ai/openharness

LiteLLM open-sourced Moyai, the cloud coding agent its own team runs. You bring a Modal account and a LiteLLM gateway, then pick the agent, like Codex, Claude Code or OpenCode. Its 79% savings figure is LiteLLM's internal estimate, not a matched benchmark. News, not a test.

LiteLLM just open-sourced its escape from a $101,872 Devin bill. Moyai — a self-hosted cloud coding agent tasked from Slack — cost ~$21,700 for the same 31 days. ~79% less. The managed-agent markup is the real AI tax. Build or buy — what is your call?
Trending AI repo: headroomlabs-ai/headroom — compresses tool outputs and logs before they reach the LLM. ★76.5k, ~20% fewer tokens for coding agents; library, proxy or MCP server.
NitroStack is LIVE on Product Hunt today! Build, test, and deploy MCP servers in one place, from first tool definition to production.
Top AI repos: stablyai/orca — one app for running a team of coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) on your own subscriptions, desktop + mobile + remote.
CLI-Anything is essentially a CLI generator that makes GUI-first applications accessible to AI agents — analyze source, generate CLI, integrate.

Agent Autoloop lets Claude Code, Codex or any CLI agent pick up cron jobs, GitHub issues and errors in the background. Before deleting data or spending money it sends a Slack or Feishu card, exits while waiting, then resumes the same session.
卡兹克今天开源 Agent-Autoloop，把等人审批改成了“存档下班”：发完卡片，Agent退出；你点了再接着干。按作者介绍，等待期间不调用模型。
发现一个值得关注的开源 AI 编程项目：Octomind！它基于 Rust 开发，将 AI Coding Agent 封装成单个二进制程序，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、DeepSeek、Ollama 等多种模型。核心亮点：MCP 原生支持，可读写代码、执行命令、调用子 Agent；支持 CLI、CI/CD、后台 Daemon、WebSocket。

Stop configuring every MCP server in every AI client. MCPJungle is a self-hosted MCP gateway for developers and teams managing multiple MCP servers. It helps you cut duplicated setup by registering servers once and connecting Claude, Cursor, Codex, or your own agents to a single endpoint.
给本地 Agent 放权操控真机，大家最怕的从来不是它点错，而是冷不丁在后台把钱给付了。DIYgod 刚开源了一个叫 Pinky 的工具，专门解决把 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 这类 Agent 接入真实手机的问题。Mac、Windows、Linux 都能跑，开源免费。

devvm 0.1.0 — one isolated VM per project folder, for you or a coding agent. Claude Code / Codex / opencode run inside the VM (settings, skills, MCP available; tokens stay on the host via a proxy). Default allowlist network; --clone gives the agent its own git clone
